title: mariscus retrofractus
intro: Mariscus retrofractus, commonly known as Asiatic pennywort or Gotu Kola, is a type of herbaceous perennial plant native to Asia and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including improving cognitive function, memory, and mood, as well as reducing anxiety and stress. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to promote wound healing and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Mariscus retrofractus include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
